verified: SDK accepts a pre-hashed EMAIL_SHA256 payload with a flat data array and an optional session.
SDK exposes custom-audience account_id and subtype, CUSTOM subtype, and POST /users.
reviewConfirmed: Email preparation: trim surrounding whitespace, lowercase, then SHA-256 as lowercase hexadecimal; no Gmail dot or plus rewriting.
POST /{custom_audience_id}/users accepts payload={schema:EMAIL_SHA256,data:[emailSha256]}; provider maximum 10000 identifiers, OM B1 sends exactly one.
Optional session uses an integer session_id unique per ad account, 1-based batch_seq and last_batch_flag.
Receipt fields include audience_id, session_id, num_received, num_invalid_entries and invalid_entry_samples.
Upload acceptance is not proof of person matching, audience eligibility or targetability.
sources.implementationNote: Separate from the CAPI conversion path. Contacts owns normalization and SHA-256; audience.member.add.v1 only validates lowercase digest format and passes it through. Check account_id and CUSTOM subtype before one form-encoded POST. Session ID derives from the first 13 hex characters of the stable correlation/audience/email digest. Never expose invalid-entry samples. Accept only a matching audience_id with num_received >= 1 and zero invalid entries; otherwise unknown, except explicit invalid entries return a constant invalid_input. No retries.
